target: Filter Controller dynamic binding preset round-trip
objective: Verify that dynamic field binding survives widget save, preset save, preset import, editor reload, and frontend render.
preconditions: Elementor dynamic tags are available in the local environment.
A Toolkit filter can select a dynamic field binding.
A preset can be saved and linked to the widget.
steps: Create a filter row and choose a dynamic field binding.
Save the widget as a preset.
Confirm the dynamic binding still appears in the widget control.
Import or link the saved preset into a fresh widget.
Render the frontend and inspect data-eit-key.
Confirm the resolver receives the expected key.
expected_result: The raw dynamic binding and normalized field key round-trip without silent loss.
pass_criteria: field_binding_dynamic remains stored in the preset.
the widget __dynamic__ field is restored when importing a preset.
the rendered frontend contains the expected data-eit-key.
a warning is shown when a dynamic binding exists but no key can be resolved.
evidence_required: saved preset JSON or admin screenshot
